name: Stat card
summary: A labelled number with an optional change badge, for dashboards and summaries.
description: Put .v-stat on a .v-card for a stat tile, or use it on its own inside another surface. Keep the label short and the value formatted for people (€12,940, not 12940).

classes.name: v-stat
classes.description: A tight stack of label, value and any extra line, aligned to the start.

classes.name: v-stat-label
classes.description: What the number is, in small secondary text.

classes.name: v-stat-value
classes.description: The number: display font, large, with tabular figures so tiles line up.

a11y: The label comes first in the markup, so screen readers hear "Monthly revenue, €12,940" in a sensible order.
Say what a change means in words (+8.2% this month), not only with a green or red badge.
For values that update live, wrap the value in a region with aria-live="polite" only if people need to hear each change.
